specs.title: ordinary sheet defers calibration data, displays unchanged fits, and records production metrics
source failures offer the bundled focus sites instead of unexplained empty charts
tile scopes are independent, reference membership survives page date changes, and reload restores it
exact KPI rows, CSV, search, pagination and sample drawer work together
monthly aggregate marks open exactly their own contributors and keyboard activation works
chart catalog searches previews and adds persistent research notes
calibration loads only runs on demand, handles an injected failure, and retries successfully
tile error boundary contains a failed chart chunk and keeps sibling charts working
snapshot exports its rows and checksum, restores them and rejects a modified file; checkpoints use saved views
mobile chart controls, data inspection and chart addition remain reachable
keyboard layout, duplicate/remove, undo and presentation retain chart state
chart figure export still produces a complete SVG with the plotted data and legend
weather, calibration and map snapshots replay saved auxiliary files without requesting them again
